claim: Local automated ordinary +inventory/+party/+use/+hold/+deposit command/model acceptance with real PostgreSQL and captured session messages; fixture setup is separate.
scope: nine existing recovery berries through the shared field-target and medicine/PP services
exact normalized item names, legacy bag aliases, real slot/name PP selection and current Fusion
raise on failed berry debit so partial inventory writes roll back with the effect
help, explicit support matrix, player-flow tests and lifecycle CI

reviewed_field_effects.Mint Berry: Cure sleep and clear saved sleep turns
reviewed_field_effects.Miracle Berry: Cure paralysis, sleep, poison, toxic poison, burn or freeze
reviewed_field_effects.Mystery Berry: Restore up to 5 PP to one current active move

mapping_review: Reviewed the primary reference item's explicit recovery callbacks. Burnt thaws freeze, Ice cures burn, Mystery restores 5 PP, and PSN Cure handles psn/tox. Existing PF2 held Burnt also cures burn and held PSN Cure handles psn only; those held differences are preserved and documented, not accepted as field mappings.
field_policy: Living injured/status/depleted-move targets only; HP/PP caps, exact active move slots/names, default first depleted move. No field confusion or revival. Consume one bag copy only on a useful effect; held copies, thresholds and triggers are independent.
source_hash_format: SHA-256 of UTF-8 normalized LF text; checked against staged and committed blobs before publication.

setup_and_cleanup.fixture_setup: Fresh private loopback PostgreSQL cluster, isolated schemas, tagged ordinary User characters, calculated HP, canonical party/Fusion/box placement and actual Trainer.add_item stock. Fixture state uses explicit SQL updates to exercise stale-cache guards.
setup_and_cleanup.transport_adapters: Capture session messages and delegate production User inventory/storage methods. Run production command parse/func, field targeting, medicine/PP, placement and SQL writers. Battle-manager lookup is absent only on this out-of-battle transport. No successful berry effect is mocked.
setup_and_cleanup.failure_injection: Failed debit (including real SQL debit followed by false), post-real-HP/status-save exceptions, and post-real-PP-save exceptions must leave complete SQL and inventory-cache snapshots unchanged. Two independent DB connections compete for every item's last copy.
setup_and_cleanup.cleanup: All isolated schemas dropped, public schema empty, private task cluster stopped. Existing databases, human characters and services untouched; no migrations.

preliminary_runs.result: 26/26 passed before the final frozen build; final verification repeats the suite after a test-only readability/import cleanup.
